title: Alchemical Distillation Chamber
description: The user operates an alchemical distillation lab where a Lantern serves as the heat source and ShaderBall2 instances represent elemental reagent orbs. Users must combine reagent orbs by dragging them over the lantern flame at correct temperatures, respecting conservation of mass, to synthesize target compounds through a multi-step reaction chain with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing an alchemical distillation chamber. Load Lantern.glb centered at the bottom of the scene as the heat source. Load ShaderBall2.glb and create 6 cloned instances arranged in a semicircle above the lantern, each tinted a different color representing elements: Red=Ignis(mass:3), Blue=Aqua(mass:5), Green=Terra(mass:4), Yellow=Aether(mass:2), Purple=Umbra(mass:6), Cyan=Lux(mass:1). Display each orb's element name and mass as HTML overlay labels. Camera: perspective at (0,3,7) looking at origin, with OrbitControls. Add warm point light inside the lantern with adjustable intensity. Add a temperature slider (100-1000°C) that controls lantern flame intensity and glow color (orange→white→blue). Core mechanic: users drag two reagent orbs onto the lantern to combine them. The product orb's mass MUST equal the sum of input masses (conservation of mass law). Each combination only succeeds at a specific temperature range (±50°C tolerance). Define 5 target compounds requiring sequential synthesis: Step1: Ignis+Aqua@300°C=Steam(mass:8), Step2: Terra+Lux@600°C=Crystal(mass:5), Step3: Steam+Crystal@450°C=Elixir(mass:13), Step4: Aether+Umbra@800°C=Void(mass:8), Step5: Elixir+Void@950°C=PhilosopherStone(mass:21). Wrong temperature shows a shake animation and returns orbs. Successful reactions play a particle burst from the lantern and spawn a new product orb with blended color. Implement full undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y) that reverses reactions, restoring consumed orbs and removing products. Display a reaction log panel on the right showing completed steps, total mass tracker, and target compound checklist. Add a reset button. Raycasting handles drag-and-drop onto the lantern's bounding box. Show success modal when PhilosopherStone is created.
